title: Scoped negative result: arbitrary source masks add no R439 helper deletion
body:
PR1079 permits one current source per deleted-helper read. This package extends that fixed-word question to **arbitrary XOR masks of current sources**, including cancellation with existing source operands and separately framed additions. It excludes every additional helper: **65** fail even unrestricted source-span membership, **364** more fail the relaxed frame-access condition, and the sole survivor is helper **470**, already constructed by Ali Romman in PR1043.

**Status: scoped negative result; no new kappa or construction.** The added evidence is a complete 430-helper / 2,102-read census and 429 explicit separating parity witnesses. Linear-span certificates cover all masks without a support-size cutoff. The proof retains local clean-response preservation and fixes nonincident A/B gates, COPY boundaries and register endpoints. It allows every rational common frame and deliberately relaxes joint donor scheduling. It does not exclude simultaneous helper deletion, reordered gates, helper-basis changes, scratch registers or errors that cancel at later boundaries.

The generator uses packed F2 rows and integer echelon geometry. A separate checker uses sets of source coordinates, rational nullspaces, independently reconstructed anchors and direct parity pairings. Both inspect the literal pinned word; neither imports the other's code or the predecessor verifier. Separate implementations do not imply independent human review.

Reproduce the complete registered package with Python 3.12 and its standard library:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-source-span-seed02
```

Expected final marker: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/bit-source-span-seed02 outcome=negative-result`.

Validation passed locally on macOS arm64 with CPython 3.12.13 and scoped controls also exercised on 3.14.6:

- Independent complete census, all 429 dual witnesses, all 636 rational frame closures, 11 certificate mutations and deterministic regeneration.
- Five package tests, including 65,536 membership decisions against explicit mask enumeration, 625 determinant cases, source cancellation, optimized minimal relocation and input-pin/source corruption controls.
- The unchanged baseline owning checker: all 661 dirty columns and original H1-H5/U/J/K/C predicates. This is baseline evidence; no new candidate is asserted.
- Source/metadata checks, staged scope and whitespace checks. Native multistage replay, a new hosted invoice, the selected cold replay, outer assembly and remote CI success are not claimed.

Exact base: **49b3157d1d89adcef16df8be98445451672be5ba**. Sole mathematical input: PR589's tuned word, SHA256 **e3e301e62bc2b41dbf1ceac0acf3d35824ebeab1848c5a2142d4577b109da52f**. Direct predecessor heads: PR1079 **bb20dab261884412f2d2a7955cdb2fd8e2e64a16** and PR1043 **e309e17f83f5759b1ea1fa24a76f24838784cb4d**. The input and selected record remain byte-identical at refreshed upstream **dd6403f774a0891093a006ae9716c02e371b1fdb**. Only the new research directory is added.

OS assignment seed **2**, bit-supplier track. TASK.json records the three alternatives, scope change, stopping rule and initial/final overlap snapshots. No pinned coordination issue existed, so the claim was recorded locally. The final scan covered 840 open PR bodies and 16 discussion records; PR1079 is the direct single-source predecessor. PR933 fixes helper stock, PR1128 studies suffix boundaries, PR1179 changes the helper basis, and PR1194 addresses semantic D. Their results are neither contradicted nor combined here.

Credit Ali Romman for the known source boundary and complete paid invoice; Hanson Sun for the prior one-source census; DreamingOfClouds and eumemic for the word and interface; and the retained E8, compiler, mutable-source and hosting contributors named in the README. Prepared for **Hanson Sun (@bbMisk)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance**, under Apache-2.0. All inherited compiler, realization, hosting, precision/tape and analytic assumptions remain; this is not formal verification of the full multiplication theorem.

The README includes the precise proof, a concrete helper224 obstruction, and an open next question requiring a changed fixed anchor and a fully charged construction.
